fields.label: Version Key
fields.description: Unique identifier for this policy version (policy name + version number). Auto-generated.

fields.label: Policy
fields.description: The Decision Policy this version belongs to.

fields.label: Version Number
fields.description: Sequential version number (0, 1, 2, ...). Incremented on each version created.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Draft: editable, unpublished. Published: immutable, active version. Retired: replaced by a newer Published version.

fields.label: Definition Json
fields.description: The policy definition (questions, rules, fallback logic). Validated on save. Immutable once published.

fields.label: Schema Version
fields.description: Schema version of the policy definition (e.g., '1.0'). Used for forward/backward compatibility.

fields.label: Fingerprint
fields.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the policy definition (computed server-side, excludes deployment identity). Used for immutability and version pinning.

fields.label: Default Model
fields.description: Default Decision Model to use when running this policy version. Can be overridden at runtime.

fields.label: Published At
fields.description: Timestamp when this version was published. Set automatically on publish; empty for Draft/Retired versions.

fields.label: Metadata Json
fields.description: Additional metadata about this version (e.g., changelog, tags). Optional.
